verdict.rationale: Orb provides configurable event-driven automation for specific billing cases: usage and credit-balance threshold alerts (also via API), real-time webhooks fired to your endpoint when certain events occur, automatic top-ups when credits are depleted, dunning retries, and automatic invoice issuance. These are fixed, billing-specific triggers rather than a general rule builder where users define their own conditions and actions; any custom actions must be built by the user on top of webhooks. Missing for 10: a general user-defined rules or workflow engine with custom conditions and actions, documentation of rule configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
